claims.claim_text: prefix cache 被當成透明的最佳化
claims.evidence: Prefix caching, in which a serving engine reuses the key and value tensors of a shared prompt prefix across requests, is enabled by default in the major open-source stacks and treated as a transparent optimization.
claims.note: Hero characterization of item 01 matches the abstract's own framing verbatim（"treated as a transparent optimization"）。

claims.claim_text: TLS 握手一律先賭 X25519
claims.evidence: always send X25519 while advertising support for other key agreement algorithms
claims.note: Cloudflare 文章明確描述舊策略為一律送出 X25519 keyshare。

claims.claim_text: Rust enum 的 alignment 悄悄把一個值撐成兩倍寬
claims.evidence: is a whole 16 bytes (128 bits) wide
claims.note: 128 bit 對語意上只需的 64 bit 即兩倍寬；來源將原因歸於 alignment。

claims.claim_text: LLM decompiler 用 recompilability 當分數卻獎勵了錯的路徑
claims.evidence: LLM-based decompilers produce clean, idiomatic C and are now judged almost entirely by recompilability and re-executability: whether the output builds and passes its shipped input/output tests
claims.note: 來源摘要同時記載通過全部隨附測試的候選仍有 4.9% 行為偏離，支持「獎勵了錯的路徑」這個特徵化。

claims.claim_text: 八十個 episode 的 agentic tool-use 工作流在 16-bit 下有 36.2% 走上不同軌跡，四位元權重下是 75.0%
claims.evidence: Holding the model, decoding parameters, seed, and request order fixed, and issuing every request serially at batch size one, we ran an eighty-episode multi-turn agentic tool-use workload with caching enabled and disabled across two engines and four weight formats. […] Enabling the cache changed the agent's trajectory on 36.2 percent of episodes at 16-bit precision and on 75.0 percent at four-bit
claims.note: 80 episodes、batch size 1、固定 seed/解碼參數/請求順序、36.2%、75.0% 全部逐項對上。

claims.claim_text: 關掉快取則 800 個 episode 全部 bit-identical，把其他不確定性來源的上界壓在 0.5%
claims.evidence: With caching disabled, repeated execution was bit-identical in every configuration, 0 of 800 episodes, which bounds other sources of nondeterminism at 0.5 percent.
claims.note: 800 episodes 與 0.5% 上界均為來源原文。

claims.claim_text: 作者的說法是，在 cache state 固定的前提下，快取本身是決定性的；真正的麻煩在於那份 state 不在 request 裡，預設也不會被重置
claims.evidence: Cached serving is deterministic given cache state, and irreproducible in practice because that state is absent from the request and never reset by default.
claims.note: 貼文加上「作者的說法是」的可見出處標記，與單一來源相符。

claims.claim_text: Q4_K_M 把 55 GB 壓成 17 GB，agentic coding 的 pass rate 大約 77%、與 BF16 打平；UD-Q2_K_XL 掉到 68% 上下
claims.evidence: BF16 (55 GB), Q8_0 (29 GB), Q4_K_M (17 GB), UD-Q2_K_XL (10.7 GB) […] Q4_K_M maintained parity with the full model, achieving approximately 77% on Terminal-Bench 2.1 […] UD-Q2_K_XL scored around 68% on the same benchmark
claims.note: 55 GB→17 GB、~77% 打平、~68% 皆對上；貼文的「agentic coding」對應來源的 Terminal-Bench 2.1，且貼文自帶「大約／上下」的模糊化，未上調來源強度。

claims.claim_text: 1-bit 在 GPQA Diamond 上直接落到亂猜的水準
claims.evidence: the scores are around the random guessing level, with the smallest model being below that threshold
claims.note: 來源在 GPQA Diamond 段落對 1-bit 量化如此描述。

claims.claim_text: Q8_0 的 Terminal-Bench 數字是內插而非實測，那批 Unsloth 量化檔在 2026 年 8 月 19 日之後也已經取不到
claims.evidence: I accidentally skipped running Q8_0; yet, in this case, I can safely interpolate between 4-bit and the full model's values […] Unsloth replaced the v2 files on 19 August 2026
claims.note: 兩項 caveat 都是作者自述，貼文也以「作者自己標了 caveat」歸屬。

claims.claim_text: 八個系統九種設定下，通過全部隨附測試的候選仍有 4.9% 偏離、單一系統最高 13%
claims.evidence: Across eight systems in nine configurations on established LLM decompilation corpora, candidates that pass every shipped test still diverge from the original on our input corpus: 4.9% overall, and as many as 13% for a single system
claims.note: 8 systems / 9 configurations / 4.9% / 13% 全部逐項對上。

claims.claim_text: 最強的 refinement LLM 把 Ghidra 的 build rate 從 75% 拉到 90%，Matched rate 卻從 74% 掉到 62%
claims.evidence: the strongest refinement LLM lifts Ghidra's build rate from 75% to 90%, while its Matched rate falls from 74% to 62%
claims.note: 四個百分比與方向完全一致。

claims.claim_text: 作者提出的 Decompile-Diverge 不靠固定測試，而是替每個函式合成 driver、從參考實作長出 fuzzing corpus，再拿同一批輸入重跑比對行為
claims.evidence: a behavioral comparison oracle not relying on fixed or hand-crafted tests […] for each function it synthesizes a driver, grows a fuzzing corpus from the reference, and reruns the decompiled code on the same inputs to detect changes
claims.note: 系統名稱與三步驟方法逐項對上。

claims.claim_text: 已揭露的漏洞甚至可能連 crash 都不見
claims.evidence: a disclosed vulnerability may disappear from the recompiled code with no visible trace of the crash
claims.note: 來源以 "may" 對沖，貼文以「甚至可能」對沖，強度一致。

claims.claim_text: Plush 這個用 Rust 寫的動態語言直譯器原本以 tagged enum 表示值，因為 alignment，每個值實際佔 128 bit，語意上只需要 64 bit
claims.evidence: a plain Rust tagged enum […] is a whole 16 bytes (128 bits) wide
claims.note: 16 bytes = 128 bit，來源將超額歸因於 alignment，且指出語意上只需 64 bit。

claims.claim_text: fixnum 是 62-bit 有號整數、tag 00、以 n << 2 存放所以能直接做算術，flonum 走 tag 10 並把 IEEE 754 的指數位元 rotate 過，immediate 用 tag 01 再配 5-bit subtag 放 nil 與 true 這類值，另外留兩種指標型別分開以便快速比較相等
claims.evidence: Signed integers that fit in a 62-bit range […] stored as `n << 2`, so add, sub, compares and bitwise and/or/xor run directly on the tagged words. […] the lowest two bits end up being `10` […] Values like `nil`, `true`, `false`, `undef`, function and class ids [with] a 5-bit subtag to indicate what kind of immediate they are.
claims.note: 四種編碼的 tag 位元、62-bit 範圍、n<<2、5-bit subtag、兩種指標型別（其一支援快速相等比較）全部對上。

claims.claim_text: array-heavy 的 benchmark 記憶體最多降 37%，每一項 benchmark 都變快、多數落在 10 到 20%，代價是整數 overflow 要 box 到 heap
claims.evidence: As much as 37% on the `mlp` benchmark which uses a lot of arrays. […] Every single benchmark is faster […] mostly 10-20%. […] The need to heap-box integers can cause some extra memory allocations in some cases
claims.note: 37%、「每一項都變快」、10-20%、heap-box 代價逐項對上；貼文未上調來源強度。

claims.claim_text: 只要 pattern 短於一個 machine word，複雜度就是文字長度的線性
claims.evidence: when the pattern $P$ is relatively short (of length less than the width of a machine word.) […] asymptotically, when the length of the pattern is bounded by a constant, the runtime of bitap is identical to that of the naive brute-force algorithm (both are linear in the length of the text $T$.)
claims.note: 來源分兩處給出 machine-word 條件與線性複雜度；貼文把兩句併成一句，未改變強度，屬可接受的合併。

claims.claim_text: 作者沒有給 benchmark，也直說預計算的成本讓它在實務上未必贏過樸素解法——它的價值在好推導，用他的話說就是換一身衣服的樸素演算法
claims.evidence: And practically, it may even perform worse than the naive algorithm in a one-off test due to the precomputation required. […] it is just the naive algorithm dressed up differently
claims.note: 文章確實未給 benchmark；「換一身衣服的樸素演算法」對應 "just the naive algorithm dressed up differently"，且貼文以「用他的話說」標示為轉述而非直引。

claims.claim_text: 把「還在進行中的比對」整包存成一個 bitset：每讀一個字元就無條件左移一位讓所有狀態前進，再跟該字元的合法轉移遮罩 AND
claims.evidence: Indeed, to advance all match states by one position, it suffices to shift left by one: `active << 1`. […] we can accomplish this by precomputing a bitset of valid states that can arise after observing the character `c` for each character that appears in the pattern, and then intersecting with the appropriate bitset.
claims.note: 左移前進與遮罩 AND 兩步驟均為來源明述。

claims.claim_text: GCC 在 middle-end 很早的一個 pass 就把 nested function 降成普通的 static function：父函式裡被存取到的變數收進一個合成的 structure，指標當成隱藏參數傳進去，於是這件事跟編譯器其他部分解耦
claims.evidence: In GCC, nested functions are lowered in an early middle-end pass. During this pass, all variables of the parent that are accessed by the nested function are collected into a single synthetic structure, and a pointer to this structure is passed to the nested function in a hidden argument. […] The main advantage of this approach is that this decouples the implementation of nested functions from the rest of the compiler
claims.note: pass 時機、合成 structure、隱藏參數、解耦四點逐項對上。

claims.claim_text: 同一個父函式裡的兩個 nested function 拿到的是同一個 frame structure 指標，C++ 則替每個 lambda expression 產生各自的物件，儘管實作不同，兩邊語意相同
claims.evidence: GCC will create a single frame structure in the parent function containing `k` and both nested functions will receive the exact same pointer to this shared environment. […] A C++ compiler will produce two separate objects for each lambda expression, each containing a reference to the same `k` variable on the stack […] the GNU C and C++ versions of this example have the exact same semantics.
claims.note: 共用 frame 指標、C++ 每個 lambda 各一物件、語意相同三點皆為原文。

claims.claim_text: 作者給的 Godbolt 例子最後被最佳化成 lea eax, [rdi+1] 加一個 ret，並提到 WG14 的 N3884 想讓這種不捕獲的 local function 用 static 儲存類別寫進標準
claims.evidence: The example optimizes down to assembly: `lea eax, [rdi+1]` followed by `ret`. […] proposal N3884 that would allow such non-capturing local functions when defined with the `static` storage class.
claims.note: 程式碼片段逐字對上；提案編號 N3884 與其內容（non-capturing local functions、static 儲存類別）亦對上。

claims.claim_text: Cloudflare 過去一律賭 X25519，對大約三成的 origin 賭錯，代價是一個 HelloRetryRequest 與 p90 多出的 150 毫秒
claims.evidence: always send X25519 while advertising support for other key agreement algorithms […] wrong for roughly 30% […] HelloRetryRequests fell from roughly 52% to 3.7%, cutting more than 150 ms off connection handshake latency at p90.
claims.note: 「大約三成」對應 "roughly 30%"；150 ms 在來源是 "more than 150 ms"，貼文寫成「多出的 150 毫秒」屬持平或略保守，非上調。

claims.claim_text: 在 production 流量之外對每個 TLS 1.3 origin 逐一試 X25519、P-256、P-384、P-521 與 X25519MLKEM768，結果按各 subdomain 的實際流量加權，再定出 per-origin 偏好
claims.evidence: a few lightweight TLS handshakes, each offering exactly one key agreement group: X25519, P-256, P-384, P-521, or X25519MLKEM768. […] a domain-wide preference reflects HTTP traffic volume rather than weighing a dormant subdomain equally with your busiest endpoint.
claims.note: 五個 group 的清單與流量加權機制逐項對上。

claims.claim_text: 掃過的 origin 上 HelloRetryRequest 從 52% 降到 3.7%，每天約 450 億條 post-quantum 連線
claims.evidence: HelloRetryRequests fell from roughly 52% to 3.7% […] Post-quantum origin traffic has grown to "45 billion per day"
claims.note: 52%→3.7% 與 450 億（45 billion）/day 均對上；貼文的「約」與來源的 "roughly" 一致。

claims.claim_text: 代價是約 0.34% 的 origin 一收到 post-quantum keyshare 就握手失敗，多半是舊 middlebox 丟掉跨多個封包的 ClientHello
claims.evidence: 0.34% of scanned origins failed to complete the TLS handshake when receiving a post-quantum keyshare first […] legacy middleboxes and origin servers […] ClientHello messages split across multiple packets
claims.note: 0.34%、失敗條件、以及歸因於舊 middlebox 丟棄跨封包 ClientHello 三點皆對上。

claims.claim_text: 作者從 archive.org 的舊瀏覽器安裝檔裡挖出 E-Certify 的兩張 512-bit RSA 根憑證，以及 IE 3.02 裡那張 VeriSign 測試用的 code signing 根
claims.evidence: root certificates were shipped with browser installers, and there are archives of both Internet Explorer and Netscape on archive.org […] Netscape 4.51 shipped a 512-bit RSA certificate authority trusted for SSL, and another for S/MIME. […] OU=Test VeriSign Commercial Software Publisher CA [in IE 3.02]
claims.note: 兩張 E-Certify 512-bit 根（SSL 與 S/MIME）與 IE 3.02 的 VeriSign 測試 code signing 根均對上。

claims.claim_text: 再用 CADO-NFS 在一台 Ryzen 9 5950X、32 條執行緒上分別跑 32 小時與 29 小時把 E-Certify 那兩張分解掉
claims.evidence: Ryzen 9 5950X desktop […] ./cado-nfs.py $N -t 32 --workdir /data/cert1 […] 32 hours to factor E-Certify RSA 512 Gold Server for SSL, and another 29 hours for E-Certify RSA 512 Gold Client for S/MIME.
claims.note: 工具、硬體、執行緒數（來源以指令列 -t 32 呈現）、兩段 32/29 小時 wall-clock 全部對上。

claims.claim_text: 這批根憑證是 1999 年 3 月隨 Netscape 4.51 出貨的，而同等規模的 RSA-155 在同年稍晚就被分解掉了
claims.evidence: Back in March 1999, Netscape 4.51 shipped a 512-bit RSA certificate authority trusted for SSL, and another for S/MIME. Later that year, the 512-bit RSA-155 was factored, so even in its era this was too weak and probably shouldn't have shipped in the first place.
claims.note: 重抓來源確認：(1)「1999 年 3 月隨 Netscape 4.51 出貨」逐字對上 "Back in March 1999, Netscape 4.51 shipped"，且該句所指正是被分解的那兩張 E-Certify 根（SSL 與 S/MIME）；(2)「同年稍晚」對應 "Later that year"，時間錨點同為 1999 年 3 月那句，模糊程度完全一致；(3) 對全文做了日期普查（1994、March 1999、1999、2002、2003-10-16、1998-10-16、1996-05-02、1997-05-02），來源任何位置都沒有給 RSA-155 分解的月份，原本被加上去的「7 月」已完全移除，無殘留的自造精確度；(4)「同等規模」對上來源的 "the 512-bit RSA-155" 與 E-Certify 的 512-bit RSA。強度上來源為斷定（was factored），貼文亦為斷定，未上調亦未下修。唯一殘留的小疑慮：前一句列了三張憑證（含 IE 3.02 的 VeriSign 測試根），「這批」在字面上可能被讀成涵蓋三張，而 IE 3.02 那張並非隨 Netscape 4.51 出貨（來源另述 "Internet Explorer seems to have never shipped any 512-bit roots for SSL"）；但子句自帶「隨 Netscape 4.51」已自我限縮範圍，且上一句的動作主體本就是被分解的 E-Certify 兩張，不構成與來源相牴觸的主張，不需再修。

claims.claim_text: 而這批根憑證是 1999 年 3 月隨 Netscape 4.51 出貨的
claims.evidence: Back in March 1999, Netscape 4.51 shipped a 512-bit RSA certificate
claims.note: 1999 年 3 月與 Netscape 4.51 皆為原文。

claims.claim_text: 私鑰到手之後，把系統時鐘調回去，簽出來的憑證在當年的 Netscape 4.51 裡就驗得過
claims.evidence: Assuming you're somehow running Netscape 4.51 with a clock set before E-Certify roots expired on 2003-10-16, you can use these private keys to issue certificates.
claims.note: 調整時鐘 + 用取得的私鑰簽發可通過驗證的憑證，與來源一致。

claims.claim_text: 沒有什麼特殊弱點，就是 512 bit 太短
claims.evidence: so even in its era this was too weak and probably shouldn't have shipped in the first place
claims.note: 來源將可分解性歸因於金鑰長度過短，未主張任何實作弱點；貼文的對照式表述與之相符。

claims.claim_text: HTTP 連線一直開著不關，持續把 CSS 更新以 60 FPS 涓滴送過去，管子、鳥與分數全靠瀏覽器重新套用樣式來移動
claims.evidence: if we keep the HTTP connection open indefinitely, we can dynamically update the page from the server, without any JavaScript! […] new CSS is constantly being sent to update the position of the pipes, the bird, and the content of the score text at 60 FPS.
claims.note: 60 FPS、常開連線、以及管子／鳥／分數三者由 CSS 更新驅動，逐項對上。

claims.claim_text: 一個蓋滿整個畫面的隱形按鈕把表單送進隱藏的 iframe，伺服器用一組自己發的 UUID 認出是哪個玩家，畫面因此不會重新載入
claims.evidence: The latter is accomplished using the iframe trick above, combined with a hidden button that covers the entire screen. […] the `uuid` value, which can be generated by the server on initial page load. This is used to tie events to the original page (to prevent mixing up users when responding to events).
claims.note: 全螢幕隱藏按鈕、iframe 提交、伺服器產生的 UUID 綁定玩家，皆為原文；iframe trick 的目的正是避免主畫面重新載入。

claims.claim_text: 普通硬體上一個 CPU core 大約撐得住 500 場遊戲、一場約吃 20 KiB/s
claims.evidence: On my simple Rust server implementation, I can run about 500 games at the same time per core on a relatively old server in my homelab. […] One game takes about 20KiB/s of bandwidth to run.
claims.note: 500 games/core、20 KiB/s 對上；貼文的「普通硬體」對應 "a relatively old server in my homelab"，並保留了來源的 "about"。

claims.claim_text: 但延遲完全由地理距離決定，隔著一座海洋就沒法玩了
claims.evidence: every time you click, it requires a round trip to the server... the demo is extremely playable if you're in Atlantic Canada... gradually gets more laggy the further you get... on the other side of the world, it's unplayable.
claims.note: 距離遞增導致 lag、最遠端不可玩，皆為來源明述。

claims.claim_text: Augur 說自己是第一個同時補上這兩點的動態預測分析
claims.evidence: the first dynamic predictive program analysis that (1) supports data store applications with complex relational queries and (2) reports only executions that violate View Serializability
claims.note: 絕對式主張在貼文中以「Augur 說自己是」明確歸屬給作者，未被改寫成中立事實，強度與來源一致。

claims.claim_text: 既有的 dynamic predictive analysis 有兩個缺口——處理不了帶複雜 predicate 的 SQL 查詢，而且會報出其實沒有違反 View Serializability 的執行
claims.evidence: cannot handle relational (i.e., SQL) queries with complex predicates […] predicts executions that do not violate View Serializability
claims.note: 兩個缺口逐項對上。

claims.claim_text: 並在 OLTP-Bench 的程式與 Spree 這套電商應用上找出可行的不可序列化執行
claims.evidence: in the widely used OLTP-Bench programs and in the widely used e-commerce application Spree
claims.note: 評估對象名稱與性質對上。
